questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Engineering Economics Principles & Time Value of Money
questions.text: Define Engineering Economics. Explain the role of engineering economics in decision making. Explain Time Value of Money (TVM), Simple Interest vs Compound Interest ($F = P(1+i)^n$), and Cash Flow Diagrams (CFD).

Derive Interest Formulas for discrete compounding: (a) Single Payment Compound Amount Factor $(F/P, i, n)$, (b) Uniform Series Present Worth Factor $(P/A, i, n)$, and (c) Capital Recovery Factor $(A/P, i, n)$. Explain Nominal vs Effective Interest Rates ($i_{eff} = (1 + r/m)^m - 1$).

Explain Project Evaluation Methods: Present Worth (PW) Method, Future Worth (FW) Method, Annual Worth (AW) Method, and Payback Period Method. Compare mutually exclusive investment alternatives with equal and unequal useful lives using MARR.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Benefit-Cost Ratio Analysis for Public & Infrastructure Projects
questions.text: Explain Internal Rate of Return (IRR) method. Explain Incremental IRR ($\Delta IRR$) analysis for comparing mutually exclusive projects. Explain Benefit-Cost Ratio ($B/C$ ratio) analysis for public sector projects.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Replacement Analysis, Inflation Effects & Sensitivity Analysis
questions.text: Explain Depreciation: Straight Line Method, Declining Balance (DB) / Double Declining Balance (DDB) method, and Sum of the Years Digits (SOYD) method. Calculate annual depreciation charge and book value after 5 years for an equipment of initial cost Rs. 1,000,000 and salvage value Rs. 100,000 with useful life 10 years.
